title: Symptom vs Root Cause Drill-Down
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: A three-layer why drill-down on Priya's first interview complaint, "I don't have time to cook." At each layer learners choose which of two answers explains the layer above; correct choices extend a clickable why trail, and dead ends (restating the symptom, a cause the interviews didn't support, or jumping to a solution) loop back with amber feedback. The root cause, rotating shifts that make any pre-planned dinner routine unreliable, is stamped Root Cause Found beneath the original symptom.

prerequisites: Chapter 5 reading through Finding the Root Cause
educational.topic: Symptom vs root cause: tracing a customer complaint to its root cause with repeated why questions
learningObjectives: Given a customer's first-stated complaint, apply a repeated why technique, choosing at each step which underlying cause to pursue, to trace the symptom down to its root cause

controls.label: Candidate answer (two per layer)
controls.purpose: Choose the answer to Priya's why question; a correct choice moves one layer deeper and a dead end loops back with feedback

controls.label: Why trail layers
controls.purpose: Jump back to any earlier layer; the layers below it are cleared

controls.label: Restart
controls.purpose: Return to the original symptom and reset the dead-end count

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Guided practice with immediate corrective feedback on each step of a why chain
keyQuestions: Does this answer explain the layer above, or only restate it?
Is this what the customer actually said, or what the founder assumes?
Is this a cause, or a solution in disguise?
commonMisconceptions: The first complaint a customer voices is the problem to solve
A true statement such as there aren't enough hours in the day is a useful explanation
A plausible cause the founder imagines is as good as one heard in interviews
Naming a solution, such as a better planning app, counts as finding the cause
assessmentOpportunities: Explain why a restated symptom is a dead end
Write a three-layer why chain for a new complaint, such as Jordan's customers saying grooming is a hassle
Explain why a meal kit that requires advance planning would miss Priya's root cause
